com.sun.tools.corba.se.idl

类 DefaultSymtabFactory

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.sun.tools.corba.se.idl.DefaultSymtabFactory
  • 所有已实现的接口:
    SymtabFactory

    public class DefaultSymtabFactory
extends Object
implements SymtabFactory
    This factory constructs the default symbol table entries, namely, those declared within the package com.sun.tools.corba.se.idl.

      • primitiveEntry

        public PrimitiveEntry primitiveEntry(String name)
        "name" can be, but is not limited to, the primitive idl type names: 'char', 'octet', 'short', 'long', etc. The reason it is not limited to these is that, as an extender, you may wish to override these names. For instance, when generating Java code, octet translates to byte, so there is an entry in Compile.overrideNames: <"octet", "byte"> and a PrimitiveEntry in the symbol table for "byte".
        指定者:
        primitiveEntry 在接口中 SymtabFactory
